gloss: course fee; tuition for a class or lecture

definitions.gloss: course fee; the fee paid to attend a class, lecture, seminar, or training program
definitions.explanation: The fee charged to attend a non-degree class, lecture series, seminar, workshop, or other training course. Distinct from university tuition ({授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}, {学費|がくひ}), which typically refers to fees for formal schooling. Common in the context of adult education, cram schools, online courses, and professional training.

examples.japanese: {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いくらです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How much is the course fee?

examples.japanese: {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦{現金|げんきん}→現金：02716_genkin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please pay the course fee in cash on the day.

examples.japanese: ⟦オンライン→オンライン：05278_onrain⟧⟦{講座|こうざ}→講座：09790_kouza⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{申|もう}し{込|こ}み→申し込み：03161_moushikomi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迷|まよ}っている→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: The fee for the online course has been raised, so I'm hesitating about whether to sign up.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{受講|じゅこう}→受講：15937_jukou⟧ ('attending a course/lecture') and ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ ('fee'). Literally 'course-attendance fee'.

USAGE:
- Most commonly seen in the context of cram schools (⟦{塾|じゅく}→塾：04702_juku⟧), cultural centers, professional training, language classes, and online learning platforms.
- Often appears on brochures and websites in phrases like {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧ ('free of charge') and {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧ ('course fee included').
- Payment verbs: pair with ⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ ('pay'), ⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧ ('pay, submit'), or the humble お⟦{支払|しはら}い→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧ in formal/business writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay the course fee
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{納|おさ}める→納める：02280_osameru⟧: to pay/submit the course fee (formal)
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free course / no fee required
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧: course fee charged separately
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: course fee included
- {受講料|じゅこうりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{振|ふ}り→振り：03714_furi⟧⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: transfer of the course fee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{授業料|じゅぎょうりょう}→授業料：14967_jugyouryou⟧: tuition — primarily used for schools and universities, where instruction takes place over a full term or year.
- ⟦{学費|がくひ}→学費：04706_gakuhi⟧: school fees / educational expenses — broader term including tuition and associated costs at formal institutions.
- ⟦{参加費|さんかひ}→参加費：11059_sankahi⟧: participation fee — used for events, conferences, and workshops rather than courses of study.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{受講|じゅこう}→受講：15937_jukou⟧: attending a course; taking a class.
- {受講生|じゅこうせい}: course participant; student of the class.
